Implemented and verified `doctor` host checks. Summary of the work:

## Requirements satisfied
- **PRE-FR-02** — Podman presence, version parsing, supported range `>= 5.7.0, < 6.0.0`, rootless-mode check, exit 2 with found/required versions and distro-specific upgrade/downgrade guidance.
- **PRE-FR-03** — `loginctl show-user <user> -p Linger`; disabled lingering fails and explains the `--restart=always` reboot consequence with `loginctl enable-linger` remediation.
- **PRE-FR-04** — git on PATH at 2.40+; failures name the found version.
- **PRE-FR-07** — stable ordered human report with a `next:` line for every non-pass check, plus a single `schemaVersion: 1` JSON document (`status`, `checks`).
- **PRE-NF-01 / PRE-NF-02 / PRD-NF-01** — local-only calls (no network), finite per-command timeouts, never reports a non-pass as pass, exits 2 on any failure, measured 1.14 s on this healthy host.

## Files created
- `src/doctor/checks.ts` — runner contract + injectable host checks (Podman, rootless, linger, git, Node, disk).
- `src/doctor/index.ts` — composition, overall status, 80-column human rendering, JSON document.
- `src/cli/commands/doctor.ts` — command handler and exit mapping.
- `tests/unit/doctor.test.ts` — 26 tests covering missing Podman, 4.9.3, 5.7.0/5.8.9 rootless, 6.1.4, rootless failure, lingering disabled/unavailable, git 2.39.2/2.40/missing, Node 22/24, disk fail/warn/pass/unreadable, report order/width, JSON shape, never-pass invariant, fake-clock 2 s budget, local-only commands.

## Files changed
- `src/cli/program.ts` — wired `doctor`, propagated its exit code through `runCli`, added injectable `runDoctor` for tests.
- `src/cli/commands/not-implemented.ts` — remediation now names `version` and `doctor`.
- `tests/unit/program.test.ts` — doctor no longer a placeholder; added exit/JSON forwarding coverage.

## Validation commands and results
| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `npm run typecheck` | exit 0 |
| `npm run lint` | exit 0 (18 files, no fixes) |
| `npm test -- tests/unit/doctor.test.ts` | 26 passed |
| `npm test` | 99 passed across 5 files |
| `npm run build` | exit 0 |
| `node dist/cli/index.js --help` | ten commands listed |
| `node dist/cli/index.js version` | `0.1.0`, exit 0 |
| `node dist/cli/index.js doctor --json` | `schemaVersion: 1`, `status: pass`, six checks, exit 0 |
| `node dist/cli/index.js doctor` | text report, exit 0, 1.14 s |

## Contract notes
- `doctor` no longer returns `NOT_IMPLEMENTED`; it returns **0** for pass/warn/skip and **2** for any failing check.
- JSON shape is `{ schemaVersion: 1, status: "pass"|"warn"|"fail", checks: [{ id, status, detail, remediation }] }` with `remediation: null` for passes.
- Stable check order/IDs: `podman`, `podman-rootless`, `linger`, `git`, `node`, `disk`.
- Default assumptions applied: Node 24 check added per feature open question 1; skip is overall `warn` but exits 0; disk warn/fail thresholds 5 GiB/2 GiB.
- Doctor uses a narrow injectable synchronous runner adapter until the shared platform runner lands; calls are shell-free and timed out at 1750 ms.

handoff.summary: Implemented the doctor host-check suite with ordered Podman/version, rootless, lingering, git, Node, and disk checks, human and schemaVersion 1 JSON output, exit 0/2 behavior, and injectable process/clock/disk fakes. Typecheck, lint, focused (26 tests), full unit suite (99 tests), build, and manual CLI checks all pass.
decisions: Added the Node.js 24 check alongside git per feature open question 1.
Skip is a non-pass status: it requires remediation, makes the overall result warn, and still exits 0.
A missing Podman binary makes the rootless check skip; a timeout or other spawn failure is a fail, not a missing binary.
Distro guidance is selected from injected /etc/os-release data, defaulting to the distribution's package manager.
Doctor uses a narrow injectable synchronous spawn adapter until the shared platform runner exists.
interfaces: DoctorCheck { id, label, status, detail, remediation }
DoctorDocument { schemaVersion: 1, status, checks: [{ id, status, detail, remediation }] }
tests: manual --help/version/doctor/doctor --json: exit 0, doctor completed in 1.14 s
warnings: doctor --json introduces the stable document {schemaVersion, status, checks}; docs must reflect the check IDs and remediation null semantics.
The default doctor process adapter is local to the doctor module until platform-engineer's shared runner is available; it remains replaceable by injection.
